notes.title: Patch 2.0.5 is oUt !
notes.content:
Small but important fixes thanks to the community reports! Keep them coming, we'll never stop to fix!
- Fixed recolored animations not appearing after Steam Deck Update
- Fixed characters remaining colored after being hit by certain endgame attacks
- Fixed crash when closing the game
- Fixed crash when stopping a looped BGS
- Fixed purple door fight

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8133343/03022ca783a7b0bc8baddc7ab260569c89364039.png[/img]

this update doesn't add any new content, BUT:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/361040]Doom & Destiny ADVANCED[/url] is a [b]brand new adventure[/b]. It's a stand alone game, set in the Doom & Destiny universe! It's like a sequel, but set in a different timeline ːFrancisAdvː ːJohnnyAdvː ːMikeAdvː ːNigelAdvː
In short, it means that you don’t need to play the first Do&De, but if you did, you’ll enjoy the wacky world and funny characters even more!

The action doesn’t stop with the 40h [b]Doom & Destiny Advanced[/b] adventure! Enter the [b]Online Arena[/b] and fight other players in asynchronous battles! ːmypizzaː
Fight and unlock 100 unique multiplayer perks, 64+ costumes and more and reach the top online leadersboard!

notes.title: Do&De Advanced, releases and SALES!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/361040/
[h1]Doom & Destiny Advanced RELEASED![/h1]
[b]Doom & Destiny Advanced is a brand new adventure[/b]. It's a stand alone game, [b]set in the Doom & Destiny universe[/b]. In short, it means that you don’t need to play the first Do&De, but if you did, you’ll enjoy the wacky world and funny characters even more! 

Venture with the most nerdy anti-heroes of all times, face a crazy adventure, defeat a mad business man and save the universe, one fetch quest at a time.
:NigelAdv: :MikeAdv: :JohnnyAdv: :FrancisAdv:

[h1]BUNDLE & Destiny![/h1]
You can also check the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1661/]Bundle & Destiny[/url] to grab further discount on the newest game, if you already own Doom & Destiny :fsm:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wGeOtBD-8xQ

notes.title: Doom & Destiny ADVANCED's just got updated!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.heartbit-interactive.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Doom-and-Destiny-2-2016-03-21-17-57-16-51.png[/img]
[h1]Doom & Destiny Advanced[/h1]
the sequel, prequel and reboot of Doom & Destiny, has just been updated with the [h1]ROTINI UPDATE![/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/361040/
A new playable class for Nigel, the [b]Summoner[/b], is now ready to unleash his waky summons on the battlefield! ːNigelAdvː

We also made Do&De Adv available for [b]MAC[/b] and [b]LINUX[/b]! ːJohnnyAdvː

#NerdsNeverDie ːPizzaAdvː
